title: Magi: The Adventures of Sinbad
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a world loosely drawn from the Arabian Nights, young Sinbad loses his father to the Parthevian empire's war and, guided by the Magi Yunan, becomes the first person to conquer a magical dungeon and bind its djinn. He sails off, gathers companions and builds a trading company and eventually his own kingdom, aiming to change a world torn by empires.
life_message: It holds up ambition joined to care for others: a leader who builds a nation where people need not suffer from war.

delivery.note: Sinbad's statecraft is shown through his choices, and his ambition is left somewhat ambiguous.

winners_losers: Sinbad and his companions win as builders of a refuge nation; militaristic empires and slavers are opposed, though Sinbad's ambition carries ambiguity.
